proposed_widenings.name: magic_item attunement qualifier: spellcaster-only
proposed_widenings.justification: The current record can express only a boolean attunement requirement. This item additionally restricts who may attune to spellcasters, which changes eligibility but has no place in the current surface.

notes: The wand otherwise fits the existing magic-item activation surface cleanly: holding-item gate, 7-charge pool, charge-scaled granted spell cast at levels 3-5, fixed DC 15 override, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction roll.
